title: The Pluralistic Moral Gap: Understanding Judgment and Value Differences between Humans and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distributional alignment of LLM binary moral judgments and the diversity of moral values expressed in free-text rationales against a broad distribution of human evaluations, using a custom 60-value taxonomy to identify over-represented and under-represented values.

Employing persona-based prompting using inferred user demographic dimensions (age, gender, and political partisanship) to evaluate whether the misalignment between human and LLM moral judgments stems from demographic representation differences.
